rca of the issue: Live-group bug RCA (confirmed by code + unit tests): Fish It group attaches the '✅ Daftar Mancing' inline button to the PENDAFTARAN DIBUKA message via a message EDIT after the initial NewMessage event. The old _join_group_button() scanned the group only once immediately after the text arrived, so the button was not yet attached; it logged 'Tombol Daftar Mancing tidak ditemukan' but the pendaftaran branch still logged '✅ Daftar Mancing ditekan' unconditionally (false success). Fix: _join_group_button now polls up to ~16s (8x2s), rescans up to 12 recent group messages per attempt, matches join_button_text case-insensitively, handles t.me/telegram.me/tg:// deep-link buttons by sending /start to the bot, and returns 'clicked'|'deeplink'|None. _cycle_group() pendaftaran branch now only marks the session active + logs success when a button was truly pressed; otherwise it logs a warning and re-sends /open_mancing.
